_comment: Alternative / belt-and-suspenders daily trigger. The Databricks Job (databricks/job_ps3_daily_workflow.json) already schedules the whole chain at 07:00 America/Chicago. Use this EventBridge Scheduler rule ONLY if you prefer AWS-side orchestration (e.g. to trigger the Databricks Jobs API, or a SageMaker Pipeline, from EventBridge). Region us-east-1.
Name: cubic-chicago-ps3-daily-trigger
Description: Fires the PS3 daily batch (Databricks silver+gold -> S3 -> SageMaker score -> RDS).

_option_A_databricks_job.note: Use an EventBridge API Destination -> Databricks Jobs API 2.1 /jobs/run-now with job_id of cubic-chicago-ps3-daily; secret via connection.
